description: State Agency Waste Management Annual Disposal Report is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CalRecycle. Public Resources Code (PRC) Section 42926 requires each State agency and large State facility to submit an Annual Waste Management Report to the California Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery (CalRecycle). Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher CalRecycle. Its tags are Buy Recycled Campaign, CalRecycle, Disposal, EPP Training Contracts, Environmentally Preferable Purchasing. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, DOCX. The portal shows 2019-10-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
